what_happened: Layout 8, red-white bendy Straw008, GlassCup023. Straw: closed on it at 586 without lifting (hold 581-596, lift 0), then hovered above it 600-970 (close on air 839; drawer bumped 576-603 and 834-858); grasped at 971-991 and lifted 0.58 m at ~984 (straw pick ~600 steps after the drawer opened; successes ~165). Navigation 995-~1400. 1380-1600 the straw was held vertically beside the cup (brief contacts 1573-1575, 1581); at ~1600-1640 the arm swung right toward a chair and released at 1640, 0.54 m from the cup; the straw fell to the floor. causal_chain: slow drawer (+190 steps) and missed first straw grasp + 380-step hover (586-970) -> at the cup only at ~1380 -> 220 steps beside the cup without inserting -> released 54 cm away (1640) -> timeout

official_criterion_notes: Official success = straw touches the cup AND straw centre < 0.5 m horizontally from the cup centre AND gripper far; there is no 'inside' or upright test, so a straw lying across the rim or leaning on the outside of the cup would count once the gripper leaves.
